Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Role Overview

The Business Intelligence (BI) Solution Developer serves as a key member of the Measurement Enablement team, responsible for ensuring client healthcare marketing data is accurate, current, and ready for reporting and analysis. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

Primary Responsibilities 

Data Ingestion & Source Management 

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new client data sources and data feeds.  
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure successful ingestion of data into Databricks.  
  • Monitor data delivery schedules and ingestion processes.  
  • Maintain source documentation, field mappings, and data inventories.  
  • Work directly with internal teams and external partners to resolve source-related issues. 

Data Quality & Stewardship 

  • Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy across client datasets.  
  • Perform ongoing quality assurance and reconciliation checks.  
  • Investigate missing, unexpected, or inconsistent data.  
  • Escalate, coordinate and resolve remediation efforts with the appropriate teams.  
  • Maintain documentation of data quality findings and resolutions.  
  • Support the development of automated data quality checks and monitoring processes. 

Data Modeling 

  • Develop and maintain client-specific standard, custom, and master tables and reporting views within Databricks based on a medallion architecture.  
  • Assist with transforming and standardizing data from multiple sources into reporting-ready structures. 
  • Solve problems and help build solutions related to the data model to meet evolving reporting and analysis needs. 
  • Document business rules, transformation logic, and metric definitions.  
  • Support maintenance of reusable reporting datasets and standardized data models. 

Stakeholder Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for routine data-related questions.  
  • Partner with Client Services, Media, Strategy, and Data teams to align on data outputs and expectations. 
  • Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements, translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting.  
  • Communicate data issues, impacts, and resolutions to stakeholders.  
  • Assist with troubleshooting data discrepancies impacting reporting deliverables. 

Reporting Support 

  • Support Power BI developers and business analysts with data-related questions.  
  • Assist with report validation and troubleshooting.  
  • Help verify data displayed in dashboards aligns with source systems and business requirements.  
  • Provide support for semantic models and reporting datasets when needed. 

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, in a Databricks environment preferrable. 
  • Experience using ETL tools and data manipulation concepts (Funnel.io, DBT, or similar applications). 
  • Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic. 
  • Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting.
  • Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs. 
  • Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis. 

Preferred / Bonus 

  • Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data).  
  • Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis). 
  • Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas.

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Avalere Healthについて
私たちは、「すべての患者さんに可能性を届ける」という共通の目的のもとで働いています。Avalere Healthは、すべての患者さんが必要な治療、支援、ケアを等しく受けられることを目指しています。Advisory、Medical、Marketingの各チームがそれぞれの専門性を生かして連携し、ヘルスケアが障壁とならず、誰一人取り残されない未来を築いています。
このミッションを実現するためには、社員一人ひとりが目的意識を持ち、患者さんの人生に具体的な変化を生み出せる環境が必要です。私たちは、多様なバックグラウンドやスキルを生かし、自分らしく働きながら、世界中の患者さんのために力を発揮できる文化づくりに取り組んでいます。

インクルーシブな文化は、私たちのすべての活動の中心にあります。Diverse Ability、Family、Gender、LGBTQ+、Mental Health、Race/Ethnicityの6つのEmployee Network Groupを通じて、社員が自分らしく働ける環境を支援しています。これらのグループは、定期的なミーティングや活動を通じて、多様性、公平性、インクルージョンを促進し、つながり、学び、交流する機会を提供しています。また、私たちはFertility Friendly認定企業として、不妊治療に関する方針、充実した育児休暇制度、柔軟な働き方を通じて、家族形成のあらゆる段階にある社員を支援しています。
日々のキャリア経験、数千に及ぶオンデマンド研修、定期的なキャリア対話、グローバルかつ部門横断的なキャリア機会を通じて、社員の継続的な成長を積極的に支援しています。

入社後は、クライアント業務を通じて、アカウントマネジメントの基礎を実践的に身につけていただきます。周囲の支援を受けながら担当範囲を広げ、将来的にはクライアントとのやり取りや、より複雑な案件進行にも関わっていただくことを期待しています。

title: PLOS One Public Health and Epidemiology Associate Editor- 12 Month FTC
description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA. 

This is a 12 month FTC

In the US, this is a union represented position as part of the Pacific Media Workers Guild, Local 39521 of the NewsGuild-Communication Workers of America.

 

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. We believe in a better future where science is open to all, for all. The Associate Editor oversees the editorial process for manuscripts submitted to PLOS journals.  This role will require the use of prior research experience, critical evaluation skills, and internal guidelines to make nuanced and complex editorial decisions. The Associate Editor works with colleagues in their division and other teams to deliver developmental and promotional activities for PLOS journals.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex and nuanced editorial queries.
  • Support other teams at PLOS, members of the editorial board, and third-party editorial teams to ensure high standards of scientific rigor and editorial integrity are upheld.
  • Evaluate submissions and make decisions based on reviewers’ comments.
  • Participate in activities to develop editorial policy and improve the visibility and reputation of journals in the PLOS portfolio.
  • Handle publication ethics queries.
  • Build relationships with members of the academic community.
  • Demonstrate a positive, constructive attitude to change and a growth mindset.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Experience in a research environment, publishing, or other relevant industry.
  • Highly organized and efficient, with strong critical assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral.
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy.
  • Able to set priorities and work independently.

Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in a relevant subject area required. A PHD, MD or similiar level is preferred. 

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is $67,000 to $73,000. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below. 

BENEFITS: 

 

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

 

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

 

 

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Retail & E-commerce
description: Jij helpt retailers om AI echt onderdeel van hun dagelijkse operatie te maken. Duizenden producten, meerdere kanalen, wisselende vraag en klanten die snel antwoord verwachten. In retail en e-commerce liggen veel kansen voor AI, maar alleen als de oplossing aansluit op processen, systemen en mensen. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. AI op het snijvlak van commerce, data en operatie Je begrijpt hoe productdata, assortiment, orderstromen, fulfilment, klantenservice en commerciële sturing samenkomen. Denk aan: Agents die productcontent voor duizenden artikelen verrijken en controleren. Een klantenservicetoepassing die retouren en leveringsvragen niet alleen beantwoordt, maar ook de vervolgstappen voorbereidt. Vraagvoorspellingen waar categoriemanagers hun beslissingen op durven te baseren. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in retail of e-commerce: je kent de processen, data en platformen van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met PIM, OMS, ERP of commerceplatformen, en met klassieke ML zoals vraagvoorspelling. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris; 27 vakantiedage

title: Mgr, Inside Sales
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Inside Sales Manager is a senior level commercial position responsible for strategically leading the Inside Sales Team. As the team leader, the Inside Sales Manager is accountable to develop inside sales strategies and tactics to support the outside sales team and grow our customer base. The team assesses and handles inbound lead calls, makes outbound sales and customer retention calls, and gathers critical sales opportunity information to pass to the field sales team. Working closely with field sales management colleagues, the Inside Sales Manager leading the Inside Sales Representatives, will develop and implement action plans to increase the customer base, maximize sales revenue and increase market share by demonstrating commitment to surpass our customers’ expectations. 

 

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:  

  • Oversee daily activities performed by the Inside Sales Team and support all escalations, driving each member toward expected weekly, monthly and quarterly goals through regular coaching and 1:1's.

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to develop and execute on quarterly call campaigns.

  • Coordinates budgets, organizing and implementing sales strategies, and is responsible for achieving overall sales objectives.

  • In conjunction with marketing and sales management, develop new product scripts and advanced qualifying questions for call campaigns.

  • Maintain and develop Inside Sales processes, lead generation, and quarterly project planning, to establish an approach for successful solution selling.

  • Develop and publish weekly/monthly performance dashboard reports for each Inside Sales Representative utilizing data captured through CRM module activity details and call metrics.

  • Prepare and present quarterly analysis to Senior Management on Inside Sales Team activities related to bookings, lead generation, meeting and quote opportunities.

  • Create monthly project summary to share with stakeholders, providing project details such as project overview, starts/end dates, number of sites to call, and setting appropriate metrics to evaluate results.

  • Influence internal and external stakeholders, such as members within Sales Administration Management, C-level, and Marketing, to help remove obstacles and support goal achievement of the Inside Sales Team.    

 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution required.

  • 2+ years of inside sales management experience.

  • 2+ year of sales experience Computer proficient in Microsoft software applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and proficiency with Sales Automation tools.

 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Sales coaching and strong relationship building skills.

  • Possesses excellent oral communication/interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to develop and grow customer relationships to secure future and recurring business.

  • Must be able to drive sales growth and achieve team goals.

  • Enthusiasm for working with a professional selling team.  

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$84,500—$105,600 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. title: Associate Business Consultant - Entry-Level Life Sciences Consulting
description:
Veeva is the industry cloud for Life Sciences. We are enabling agentic biopharma through applications, agents, data, and consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
 
Consulting is changing, and Veeva Business Consulting is not like other firms. Launched in 2019, we’ve grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep industry knowledge and unique insights to accelerate drug development and commercialization for our customers.
 
We are growing aggressively and seeking great people to help Life Sciences work in a more efficient and connected way, shaping the future of the industry with the world’s leading AI applications, agents, and data at their back.
 
The Role
We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of consultants through our Business Consultant Development Program (BCDP).
 
We believe in pushing high potential people to achieve excellence. Our program is specifically designed to provide a challenging environment to learn quickly and deliver value early. You will collaborate with experienced team members on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions.
 
In our structured 18 month program, we equip you with the resources to develop the core consulting skills, deep domain expertise, and leadership foundation for long-term career success at Veeva.
 
BCDP spans five core practice areas: Analytics, Commercial, Content, R&D, and Quality. As an Associate Consultant you will align to one of those practices, allowing you to build targeted industry expertise. You will be asked to choose your preferred practice in the application process.
 
You can learn more about our practices and the work we do here.
 
The anticipated start date is September 2027.
 Work Authorization: Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the European Union. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status for this employment position. Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can choose to work in an office or remotely from home on any given day of the week - it’s up to you! Although Veeva is Work from Anywhere, Associate Business Consultants must live within a maximum commuting distance of 45 minutes to 1 hour from Veeva’s Berlin or Frankfurt offices. #LI-Remote #LI-Entry Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris; 27 vak

title: HR Generalist
description:
About Truveta

Truveta is on a mission to save lives with data. We are building the world's largest and most comprehensive health data platform to accelerate scientific discovery, improve patient care, and enable the next generation of AI-driven healthcare. Our India Development Center (IDC) plays a critical role in scaling our engineering, product, and business operations globally.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an HR Generalist who is passionate about creating exceptional employee experiences and helping build a high-performing organization.

The Opportunity

As an HR Generalist, you will support the day-to-day People operations for our growing India Development Center and help manage the employee lifecycle from onboarding through offboarding. You will work closely with employees, managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth HR operations and a positive employee experience. As the IDC continues to scale, you will also provide support for Talent Acquisition activities, including sourcing, interview coordination, candidate engagement, and hiring operations.

This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure across HR operations, employee engagement, Talent Acquisition, and other People initiatives while helping build and scale our People function in India.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

  • Provide day-to-day HR support and guidance to employees and managers.
  • Manage employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, confirmations, promotions, internal transfers, documentation, and offboarding.
  • Deliver a smooth and engaging onboarding experience for new hires.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and ensure HR systems are updated in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, IT, and other teams to ensure seamless HR operations.
  • Support employee queries related to HR policies, processes, benefits, payroll, and other People matters.
  • Support compliance with company policies, Indian labor laws, and statutory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve HR processes.

Talent Acquisition Support

  • Support the Talent Acquisition function as hiring continues to scale in India.
  • Assist with sourcing and identifying candidates for open positions.
  • Coordinate interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels.
  • Manage candidate communication, scheduling, and interview follow-ups.
  • Maintain accurate candidate information and hiring status in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Support offer coordination, pre-joining engagement, and transition of candidates into onboarding.
  • Help maintain hiring trackers, reports, and recruitment dashboards.
  • Ensure candidates have a positive and well-coordinated experience throughout the hiring process.

Employee Engagement & People Initiatives

  • Support employee engagement, recognition, wellness, and culture-building programs.
  • Assist with employee communications and People-related events and initiatives.
  • Support HR projects and organizational initiatives as the India Development Center continues to grow.
  • Partner with the broader People team on programs that enhance the overall employee experience.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • MBA/PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.
  • 2–4 years of experience in an HR Generalist or HR Operations role.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle.
  • Some exposure to Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination, or candidate sourcing is preferred.
  • Experience working with HR systems and/or Applicant Tracking Systems.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and integrity.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and growing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a fast-growing technology or product organization.
  • Exposure to recruiting for technology or engineering roles.
  • Exposure to employee engagement, performance management, and HR analytics.
  • Working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory compliance.
  • Experience with platforms such as Greenhouse, Workday, BambooHR, or similar HR/ATS systems.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to work independently as the organization scales.

title: Growth Engineer
description: About Peec AI AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions. Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role We are hiring a Fullstack Engineer for our Growth team. You will run experiments across the whole self-serve journey: from the moment someone first hears of Peec AI to the day they renew, refer a friend or leave. That covers the website, signup, pricing and checkout, the trial and onboarding. It also covers the moments in the product where we ask people to do something, like connect a tool, invite a teammate or upgrade. You can work on any of these, and we decide together where the focus goes each month or quarter. You come up with the hypothesis, design the experiment and discuss it with the team. Then you run the rest of the loop yourself: build it, instrument it, ship it behind a flag, read the result and write down what happened. You report to the VP of Growth and work with our Growth PM, our growth engineer, and the marketing and design teams. What you'll do Go after big swings. We size every idea first and look for changes that could move a funnel step by 30 to 40 percentage points. It is fine if most of them fail. Build and improve the experimentation infrastructure. Feature flags, assignment at the account level, exposure logged when someone becomes eligible, outcomes recorded on the server, and holdouts we read. Keep conversion data accurate. Event design, funnel definitions and readouts the team can rely on. Own what you ship after launch. You watch it, read the result on the date you set, and decide whether we keep it, change it or remove it. Build internal tools that let the team run more experiments with less manual work. What we're looking for You have run growth experiments end to end. You formed the hypothesis, designed the test, built it and read the result. Not advised on them, not analysed someone else's. You write production code today. Strong React and TypeScript on the frontend, comfortable in Node.js and databases on the backend. Our stack is React, Node.js and Next.js. You know what your volume can detect. You can size a test, say how long it needs to run, and tell us when a result is not readable. SQL and analytics fluency. Funnels, cohorts, event design. B2B SaaS experience. You ship with Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent. Product judgement. You can tell which changes need a test, which can ship without one, and which are not worth building. Product taste. You care about how the things you ship look and feel. You can turn an idea into a screen that belongs in our product, and you know when to bring in our design team. Bonus points You set up an experimentation practice from scratch and grew it into a regular part of how the team works. Product-led growth experience. Onboarding, activation, paywalls, pricing, checkout. Acquisition experience. Website and signup experiments, SEO or paid funnels. Experiments on low-volume B2B funnels, where only big changes are readable. Experimentation platforms and feature flags. Statsig, GrowthBook, PostHog, or your own. Billing and subscriptions. Stripe or similar. You founded a company, or you were an early engineer at one. Side projects and experiments you can show us. title: Human Resources Assistant/Talent Acquisition & Development
description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates (CRA) is a leading global consulting firm specializing in economic, financial, and management consulting services. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its unique combination of functional expertise and industry knowledge, and for its objective solutions to complex problems.

Position Overview

Our inspiring, motivated and action-driven team resides in multiple offices across North America and Europe and uses web-based project management and collaboration tools. We work with senior leadership who embrace new ideas and methodologies.

title: Solution Marketing Manager | Luma
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need

Scientists are solving some of the hardest problems in the world. Your job is to make sure they find the tools that help them do it. 

As a Solution Marketing Manager at Dotmatics, you'll work at the center of science and communication, deeply understanding how researchers in your application area think, what they're trying to accomplish, and what gets in their way. You'll translate that understanding into stories, campaigns, and content that connect scientists with the right solutions at the right moment. 

From a product perspective, Luma and ELN are your primary vehicles. Both require messaging that works at the enterprise level and resonates with specific scientific audiences. Dotmatics also has a broad portfolio of specialized products, each with their own dedicated marketers. Your job is not to own those products, but to connect them into compelling solution narratives when they're relevant to your audience and use case. 

We're looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how scientists work, who loves the challenge of making complex ideas land, and who finds real satisfaction in building something from the ground up. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk. 

In this role you will get to: 

  • Own the positioning, messaging, and content development for your scientific application area: personas, use cases, value propositions, differentiation, and collateral.
  • Develop strategic campaign briefs that translate positioning into actionable guidance for demand generation and integrated marketing.
  • Build and maintain sales enablement materials that help the Dotmatics commercial team have better conversations, including pitch frameworks, solution narratives, objection handling, and competitive context.
  • Partner with the wider marketing team to deliver the message to the market.
  • Engage directly with internal subject matter experts and customers to gather insights and shape strategy.
  • Act as the voice of your scientific audience across marketing and sales, influencing decisions and building alignment across senior stakeholders. 

We are looking for people who have 5+ years in a role where science and communication intersect: marketing, field applications, science communications, or similar, ideally in life sciences or research software. 

  • Scientific grounding to have credible conversations with researchers. A degree in a relevant discipline can be a real advantage here, and relevant hands-on experience is equally welcome.
  • A track record of taking something complicated and making it click for an audience who didn't have time to become an expert.
  • You've had the chance to build something from scratch before, and you want to do it again.
  • You're comfortable working across functions and influencing without direct authority. 

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. 

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture. Check out our principles to see how we work. Your mission telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. We have a product already used by leading B2C businesses, but the French market is still at the beginning. We will earn our place, one customer at a time. We are outbound first. As a founding Enterprise Account Executive, you will create opportunities, win major French accounts, and help define how telli sells in this market. You will carry a quota and own the hard parts of the deal, from the first cold conversation to signature. Your work will shape the playbook for the team that follows. You are based in Paris and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding. You are ready to travel and visit prospects across France when needed. You may not be a good fit if You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other. You expect a ready-made book of business or marketing to build your pipeline. You want to join deals only after discovery, and avoid cold outreach or the hard follow-through between meetings. You need a fixed playbook before acting or pass on ownership when a deal gets messy. You dislike working across executive, operations, IT, legal, and procurement stakeholders or learning openly from losses. The reality of the role France is a new market for us. There is no mature local playbook or book of business waiting for you. Some deals will be messy, and you will need to create momentum yourself. If you want ownership, direct feedback, ambitious colleagues, and the chance to do the best work of your career, this is the opportunity. The hiring process The hiring process itself is a case study in how you sell. Approach it as you would a complex account: research us, form a point of view, earn attention, ask and listen, follow through, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the judgment and ownership you would bring to winning enterprise customers in France. title: Technical Escalations Engineer 2 (Alerting) - EMEA
description:
The Team

As Datadog’s in-house product experts, the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team plays a critical role in driving our global success. We enable our customers, from the world’s most innovative startups to the largest enterprises.

As part of our TEE team, you’ll tackle the most challenging technical problems, collaborate directly with Engineering and Product to refine and evolve our platform, and mentor teams worldwide, elevating the technical bar at every level.

Role Summary

As part of the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team, you’ll operate at the heart of Datadog’s ecosystem, working at the intersection of Technical Solutions, Engineering, Product, and our Customers. Every challenge you take on will directly impact the performance, scalability, and success of both our clients and our platform. You’ll be in an environment that moves fast, challenges you daily, and rewards curiosity, ownership, and technical excellence.

This is your chance to shape the future of observability and security, driving innovation, mentoring teams, and influencing product direction while witnessing your expertise make an immediate and lasting impact.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Become the global expert on Alerting & Monitoring within the Technical Solutions team, supporting TSEs and customers in building reliable, actionable monitors.
  • Own investigations into alert-related escalations, identifying root causes across metric behavior, configuration edge cases, and backend evaluation logic.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to flag inconsistent monitor behavior, propose enhancements, and ensure alignment with user expectations.
  • Develop scalable diagnostics, reusable response strategies, and field-ready resources to shorten time to resolution.
  • Lead enablement efforts, from async training to live office hours, ensuring that Solutions teams worldwide understand Datadog’s alerting system.


 

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in debugging alert misfires, delayed or missing notifications, noisy monitors, and complex alerting logic involving scopes, groups, and recovery thresholds.
  • Comfortable interpreting how data aggregation, gaps, or late points affect alert evaluation and incident response.
  • Confident navigating APIs, tagging strategies, downtime configurations, and best practices for scalable alerting.
  • Passionate about helping customers reduce alert fatigue while increasing visibility into meaningful signals.

Bonus points

  • Familiar with Datadog’s alerting system, from monitor types (metric, composite, anomaly, logs, SLO, etc.) to thresholds, evaluation windows, and notification rules.

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based scientific expert responsible for engaging healthcare providers, generating insights, and supporting Medical Affairs priorities across Natera’s oncology portfolio, including our personalized minimal residual disease (MRD) testing. This role focuses on building strong scientific relationships, delivering clear and accurate education, and bringing back actionable insights from the field. You will own your territory, make decisions independently, and deliver clear clinical data to providers to help them make better-informed decisions.

Territory: North Texas, Arkansas, Omaha

 

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Establish and maintain scientific relationships with healthcare providers and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within a defined territory.

  • Deliver accurate, balanced, and clinically relevant education on Natera’s oncology products and data.

  • Deliver on territory plans aligned to Medical Affairs priorities.

  • Identify and communicate field insights, including treatment trends, unmet needs, and competitive dynamics.

  • Respond to unsolicited medical inquiries in a timely, compliant, and scientifically rigorous manner.

  • Support execution of Medical Affairs initiatives including advisory boards and medical education programs.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of disease states, clinical data, and the evolving oncology landscape.

  • Collaborate directly with Sales, Marketing, and R&D to move work forward without relying on rigid processes.

  • Maintain medical independence and strict compliance, always keeping the patient at the center of your work.

  • Support and coordinate clinical trial and research initiatives at academic institutions and study sites.

  • Meet all metrics as assigned and complete appropriate documentation and tracking of field visits, insights, and research opportunities.

  • Travel extensively (over 60%) as required.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced healthcare/scientific degree preferred (Ph.D., Pharm.D, M.D., D.N.P.). Master’s degree required.

  • Diagnostic, IVD, or device experience preferred.

  • Must live within the assigned territory.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Clear communicator and independent thinker.

  • Ability to work remotely while maintaining a strong teamwork ethic.

  • Make evidence-based decisions quickly and operate with urgency to get meaningful products to clinicians without compromising quality.

  • Use strategic thinking to contribute to product, departmental, and organizational plans and goals.

  • Adapt quickly when priorities shift and solve problems rather than waiting for structure.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to read, interpret, and convey complex scientific information.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Remote position requiring frequent sitting, standing, walking, and daily computer use.

  • Extensive travel required.

  • Requires the ability to communicate over the telephone and read printed material.

  • Duties may require working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

  • Complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training, and security training within the first 30 days of hire.

  • Reasonable accommodations available for individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$137,400—$171,700 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. description: Le Groupe QUALTECH - 5 sociétés, 7 sites et 350 salariés - est un regroupement de Laboratoires spécialisés dans les analyses de laboratoire (microbiologie, biologie moléculaire, chimie, extraction d’ADN, etc), le conseil, la recherche et la formation. Notre but est de garantir une expertise qualitative à nos clients en termes de contrôle, de qualité et de fiabilité dans le secteur del’agro-alimentaire. Nos valeurs : intégrité, innovation, expertise, engagement, orientation client. En rejoignant son laboratoire AGROBIO spécialisé en microbiologie, vous participez à son expertise dans le monde de la recherche et de l’analyse agro-alimentaire. Dans le cadre d'un remplacement pour congé maternité au sein de notre équipe du laboratoire AGROBIO, nous recherchons un auditeur préleveur (H/F) pour prélever des échantillons (alimentaires, d’eau et de surface) et réaliser des audits chez nos clients situés à Paris en en 1ère couronne. Vos missions Vous allez avoir l’opportunité de rencontrer les différents acteurs locaux et de découvrir leur activité, qu’ils soient spécialisés dans la restauration collective (crèches, lycées, maisons de retraite, restaurants d’entreprise, armé, etc.) ou dans la restauration plus traditionnelle. Vous êtes le 1er maillon de cette longue chaîne menant à une analyse de haute fiabilité grâce à la collaboration de chacun. Derrière vous, une équipe logistique présente à tout moment pour vous aider, des laborantins impatients de traiter vos échantillons et des clients à rassurer sur leurs bonnes pratiques vis-à-vis du grand public. Et avec vous : un véhicule de service, un téléphone, une tablette ainsi que des paniers repas. Enfin, une formation sera assurée en interne à votre prise de poste. La connaissance de la méthode HACCP sera considérée comme un atout dans votre candidature. Permis de conduire obtenu en boîte manuelle requis. Le métier en images : : https://youtu.be/vioxi-NwhKw?si=KQa-25yyois94FvA Type de contrat : CDD, temps plein (35h) Durée du contrat : environ 6 mois Date de prise de poste : dès à présent Salaire : à partir de 2017.02€ bruts/mois (selon expérience) Organisation : du lundi au vendredi. Découchages ponctuels (en cas de remplacement et de formation) Vos compétences BAC+2 en agro-alimentaire/QHSE/restauration/diététique OU expérience de 2 ans dans ces secteurs Permis B en boîte manuelle Avantages Véhicule de service, téléphone, tablette, paniers repas (13.40€/jour), PERCO, CET, offres avantageuses du CSE, Mutuelle Si vous aimez conduire, faire connaissance avec les différents acteurs locaux et que vous vous y connaissez dans les métiers de l’agro-alimentaire/restauration/qualité, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter ! title: Stage – Développement de projets de stockage d’energie par batteries (BESS) (F/H/X)
description: Localisation Poste basé à Avignon (84). Vous souhaitez découvrir concrètement comment se développent les projets de stockage par batteries et contribuer à la transition énergétique ? Au sein de l’équipe Novar en France, vous serez accompagné·e par les équipes de développement et les supports techniques. Vous participerez, à votre niveau, à l’identification de sites et à la préparation des premières analyses et démarches d’autorisation pour des projets de stockage. Vous accompagnerez également dans leurs missions de développement de projets solaires les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets et les Chef.fe .s de projets. Vos missions · Identification de sites pour des projets de stockage par batteries. Pour cela, un travail d’analyse et de suivi des évolutions techniques et réglementaires devra être réalisé. · Analyses et prédimensionnement du projet de stockage sur la base des informations collectées (caractéristiques du réseau électrique à proximité ; règles d’urbanismes ; enjeux liés à l’occupation du sol, aux accès, au voisinage et aux zonages environnementaux). · Préparer des supports de synthèse (recherches documentaires, cartographie et tableaux de suivi) et apprendre à faire ressortir les principaux points à approfondir. · Accompagner les Chef.fe .s de projet en Développement et les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets dans leurs missions et se familiariser avec les démarches de sécurisation foncière, de développement de projets et de permitting sous leurs supervisions. Votre profil · Bac +5 type Master ou Ingénieur généraliste ou énergie . · Un intérêt marqué pour les énergies renouvelables, les systèmes électriques et la transition énergétique. · À l’aise avec la recherche, l’analyse et la synthèse d’informations, ainsi qu’avec la rédaction de documents clairs. · Rigueur, autonomie, curiosité et esprit d’équipe. · Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques ; la connaissance des outils SIG ou de la réglementation en urbanisme et en environnement constitue un plus. · Bon niveau de français ; la connaissance de l’anglais est appréciée dans notre environnement international. Ce que NOVAR vous offre Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte? 💰 Une gratification de stage de 900 € par mois, dans le respect de la réglementation en vigueur. 🚆 Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport en commun. 📚 Des opportunités de développement et de croissance au sein de notre scale-up international. À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 7 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2035. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain. Intéressé(e) ? Prêt(e) pour la prochaine étape de votre carrière ? title: Learning Disabilities Support Worker- Fleet
description:
Support Worker within Mental Health Services / Support Worker within Learning Disability Services

LOCATION: Fleet, Hampshire

PAY RATES: £16.81 - £21.01 per hour (including holiday pay).

Shifts -24/7 support, Monday to Sunday

  • Day shifts between 8.00am and 8.00 pm
  • Waking night and sleep-in shift opportunities
  • Support is delivered on a 2:1 basis
  • Drivers required

Make a lasting impact by building meaningful relationships.

At Thornbury Community Services (TCS), we believe exceptional care starts with genuine connections. We’re looking for Support Worker within Mental Health Services / Support Worker within Learning Disability Services who are committed to making a real difference, people who truly care and want to build long-term partnerships with those they support.

This isn’t just a job; it’s an opportunity to support a young adult with foetal alcohol spectrum disorder, autism and ADHD to live safely and independently in their own home.

Working as part of a consistent two-person support team, you will provide structured, person-centred care across both daytime and overnight shifts. You will help the individual maintain their independence, access the community, manage daily routines and work towards their personal goals.

The individual has their own vehicle for the support team to drive. At least one Support Worker on every shift must therefore be an approved driver with the appropriate documentation and checks in place.

What You’ll Do

· Deliver person-centered care within the client’s own home.

· Maintain safety whilst making positive risk decisions.

· Enrich life and promote independence.

· Build trust and long-term relationships that make every day meaningful.

What We Offer

We value our support workers and provide a benefits package designed to help you thrive:

· Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – confidential wellbeing support.

· Travel and mileage expenses – reimbursed for your shifts.

· Exceptional pay rates – among the highest in the UK.

· Bespoke training and competency development – keep growing in your career.

What We’re Looking For

We want passionate, resilient professionals who can commit to delivering care without exception. To join our team, you’ll need:

· 12 months UK-based experience in a community setting.

· Confidence in maintaining risk and using physical intervention where required.

· Confidence in utilising PBS standards within services.

· Strong personal values and ethical standards.

· Dedication, commitment and stability.

· A genuine desire to build lasting relationships and make a positive impact.

Why Choose TCS?

Joining Thornbury means joining a compassionate team that values people—not just as clients, but as individuals. You’ll enjoy job satisfaction, and the chance to make a difference that lasts.

Apply Today

Ready to start a role where care goes beyond tasks and becomes a relationship? Click Apply Now and our team will be in touch.

For questions, contact us at:

· Email: ldamhapplications@thornburycommunityservices.co.uk

· Phone: 0333 034 1135

Véritables relais opérationnels de terrain , vous veillez au bon déroulement des prestations, au respect des procédures et des consignes de sécurité, ainsi qu’à la qualité du service rendu aux clients et aux usagers. Vous êtes en lien étroit avec les conducteurs, les établissements, le service exploitation et le référent manager. Rejoignez GROUPE M SERVICE, une entreprise dévouée au transport de personnes à mobilité réduite, en tant que référent (e) de proximité. Située à Aulnay-sous-Bois, notre société opère dans l'industrie du transport terrestre de passagers et compte entre 201 et 500 employés engagés. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés par l'assistance aux personnes vulnérables, capables de gérer les défis quotidiens avec compétence et bienveillance. Suivi opérationnel des prestations Contrôler les véhicules à leur arrivée et à leur départ. Vérifier la bonne mise en place des circuits et la disponibilité du matériel nécessaire. title: Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems
description: VisionSpace is a dynamic consulting, technology and engineering company delivering solutions and services for the Space and Defence sectors. We work across satellite operations, ground data systems, ground stations, automation, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. Our motto is Space and Beyond is Our Playground . We empower our customers to shape the future of satellite operations by bringing automation and intelligence into operational systems. About the Role We are looking for a Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems Engineer to join our team supporting activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt, Germany . The position will support the CGSS project , an established operational project responsible for an application used to generate ground station pass schedules for EUMETSAT missions . The successful candidate will contribute to the development, maintenance, verification and evolution of the application and will work closely with engineers, operational teams and end users. This is a great opportunity for a professionals in applying their technical skills to operational satellite ground systems and mission planning. What You'll Be Doing Your responsibilities will include: Contributing to the development, maintenance and evolution of the CGSS application . Developing and maintaining software components, with a particular focus on Python-based development . Supporting the development and maintenance of web-based applications and interfaces . Analysing software requirements and translating operational needs into technical solutions. Performing software Verification & Validation (V&V) activities. Preparing and executing functional, integration, regression and acceptance tests. Investigating and troubleshooting software anomalies and supporting their resolution. Supporting the integration and deployment of software releases. Contributing to technical and user documentation. Working directly with end users and operational stakeholders to understand requirements, collect feedback and support effective use of the system. Contributing to the reliability and maintainability of software used within an operational space environment. Working closely with other engineering teams involved in mission planning, ground station systems and satellite operations. What We Look For You do not need to fulfil every requirement below . We are looking for candidates who combine several of these skills and are motivated to develop further within the space operations domain. Technical Experience Ideally, you will bring experience in several of the following areas: Software engineering and the software development lifecycle. Python development . Development of web-based applications . Software Verification & Validation , testing and quality assurance. Requirements analysis and software documentation. Version control and collaborative development environments, preferably using tools such as Git/GitLab . CI/CD, automated testing or software deployment processes. Linux-based development or operational environments. Space Domain Experience Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following would be highly desirable: Satellite or spacecraft operations . Mission Planning Systems or scheduling applications. Ground segment software and operational systems. Ground Station Monitoring and Control systems . Ground station scheduling, pass planning or contact planning. Integration of mission planning applications with other mission control or ground segment systems. Working with operational teams or end users in a mission-critical environment. Previous experience with EUMETSAT, ESA or comparable European space programmes would be an advantage, but is not mandatory . Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering , or another relevant technical discipline. Relevant professional experience in a similar role is a plus. Personal Skills We're looking for someone who: Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Enjoys working directly with technical and operational end users. Can communicate effectively with both software engineers and operational stakeholders. Takes a structured and reliable approach to development, testing and troubleshooting. Can work independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary team. Is curious and willing to learn about mission planning and satellite ground operations. Has good attention to detail, particularly when working with operational software and verification activities. Has English language proficiency at C1 level or above, both written and spoken. Additional Requirements Candidates must have the right to work in the European Union . The role is expected to support activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt , so candidates should be willing and able to work from Darmstadt according to the operational needs of the service. Availability to start as early as possible in 2027 , ideally during the first quarter of the year and preferably no later than April 2027 . Ready to join us? If you are passionate about software engineering and would like to apply your skills to real-world satellite operations, we'd love to hear from you . Even if you don't tick every box, we encourage you to apply. A strong background in several of the areas above, combined with the willingness to learn, may be exactly what we're looking for. Apply today! VisionSpace Technologies is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.
